mapper.select: SELECT id, cn_text AS cnText, language_code AS languageCode, original_translation AS originalTranslation, corrected_translation AS correctedTranslation, IFNULL(corrected_translation, original_translation) AS translation, is_corrected AS isCorrected, translation_source AS translationSource, create_time AS createTime, update_time AS updateTime FROM ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_language_translation WHERE cn_text = #{cnText} AND language_code = #{languageCode} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ${database.prefix.userms}hou_base_language_translation (cn_text, language_code, original_translation, corrected_translation, is_corrected, translation_source) VALUES
( #{item.cnText}, #{item.languageCode}, #{item.originalTranslation}, #{item.correctedTranslation}, #{item.isCorrected}, #{item.translationSource} )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE original_translation = VALUES(original_translation), update_time = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
